# Chameleon - StealthX Platform
> Local-first Android privacy research client with encrypted storage, rules, geofencing and decoy components.
> Current alpha features and network use are described at https://chameleon.stealthx.tech/privacy.html.

## Current Status
- Public GitHub APK: v0.1.9-alpha
- Google Play: v0.1.13-alpha available only to selected closed testers
- Target platform: Android 8.0+; current Play build targets Android 16 / API 36
- Overlay and cross-device messenger paths remain disabled pending interoperability and physical-device verification

## Privacy And Network Use
- Rules, geofences, private keys, encrypted files and settings are stored locally
- Optional contact exchange, encrypted message relay and activation verification use limited encrypted network processing
- No advertising SDK, analytics SDK, crash-reporting SDK or Android advertising-ID integration
- Private keys never leave the device; relayed message content is end-to-end encrypted

## Paid Access And IFR
- One Android app covers Free, Pro and Elite
- Paid access uses a server-signed, device-bound activation code
- No WalletConnect, wallet address input, Ethereum RPC lookup or IFR tier cache exists in the Android app
- The planned IFR holder discount is browser-only before purchase and currently disabled pending payment and Greek fiscal approval
- Any positive IFR balance qualifies for the seller-displayed discount; there is no token-amount tier threshold
